steps.title: Prepare Primer Stock Dilutions
steps.instruction: Resuspend lyophilized primers to 100 µM (Stock dilution 1) in a Master Mix Hood or Clean Room.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Primer Scheme 2kb_v1 Pool 1: Add 20 µL of each of the 18 primers (F1, R1, F3, R3, F5, R5, F7, R7, F9, R9, F11, R11, F13, R13, F15, R15, F17, R17) to a 1.5mL tube (Final volume: 360 µL).
Prepare Primer Scheme 2kb_v1 Pool 2: Add 20 µL of each of the 16 primers (F2, R2, F4, R4, F6, R6, F8, R8, F10, R10, F12, R12, F14, R14, F16, R16) to a 1.5mL tube (Final volume: 320 µL).

steps.title: Prepare 10 µM Primer Pools
steps.instruction: Dilute the stock pools to a working concentration of 10 µM.

substeps.instruction: For Pool 1: Add 20 µL of 100 µM Pool 1 (stock dilution 2) and 180 µL of nuclease-free water to a 1.5mL tube (Final volume: 200 µL).
For Pool 2: Add 20 µL of 100 µM Pool 2 (stock dilution 2) and 180 µL of nuclease-free water to a 1.5mL tube (Final volume: 200 µL).

steps.title: Prepare Master Mix RT_2
steps.instruction: Prepare the following components in a 1.5mL tube and keep on ice (7 µL per sample):

substeps.instruction: 4 µL 5x SSIV Buffer
1 µL 100mM DTT
1 µL RNAseOUT RNase Inhibitor
1 µL SSIV Reverse transcriptase

steps.title: Perform cDNA Synthesis
steps.instruction: Conduct the following steps in the pre-PCR area.

substeps.instruction: Set thermocycler to 65 °C.
Spin down Master Mix RT_1.
Add 11 µL RNA to each 0.2 mL tube containing Master Mix RT_1.
Mix by pipetting and pulse centrifuge.
Incubate at 65 °C for 00:05:00.
Add 7 µL of Master Mix RT_2 to each tube.
Mix by pipetting and pulse centrifuge.
Incubate in thermocycler at 42 °C for 00:50:00, then 70 °C for 00:10:00, followed by a 4 °C hold.

steps.title: Perform PCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Conduct the following steps in the pre-PCR area.

substeps.instruction: Set thermocycler conditions: 1 cycle 98 °C for 00:02:00 (Heat Activation); 35 cycles of 98 °C for 00:00:10 (Denaturation), 65 °C for 00:05:00 (Annealing); 1 cycle 4 °C Hold.
Add 2.5 µL cDNA of each sample to 0.2mL 8-strip PCR tubes containing Master Mix PCR Pool 1 and Master Mix PCR Pool 2.
Mix by pipetting and pulse centrifuge.
Incubate in the thermocycler using the specified conditions.

steps.title: Purify DNA using Ampure Beads
steps.instruction: Conduct this step in the PCR room. Use fresh 80% (v/v) ethanol. Keep beads and Qubit standards at room temperature for 15 minutes before starting.

substeps.instruction: Mix Pool 1 and Pool 2 after RT-PCR (final volume 50 µL).
Add 50 µL AmpureXP PCR Clean-up beads (1:1 ratio).
Mix gently by flicking or pipetting 8-10 times (avoid vortexing for 2 Kb reads).
Incubate for 00:05:00 at room temperature.
Pulse centrifuge and place on a magnetic rack for 00:02:00 or until the solution is clear.
Discard the solution without displacing the bead pellet.
Add 200 µL fresh room-temperature 80% (v/v) ethanol to the pellet and incubate for 00:01:00.
Discard ethanol and repeat the ethanol wash (steps 13-15) once more.
Pulse centrifuge and remove residual ethanol with a 10 µL tip.
Air dry the pellet for 00:02:00 (do not over-dry; pellet should be opaque and slightly shiny).
Resuspend pellet in 32 µL water and incubate for 00:02:00.
Place on magnet and transfer 32 µL of solution to a clean 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube, ensuring no beads are transferred.

steps.title: Quantify DNA using Qubit
steps.instruction: Quantify 2 µL of the amplicon library using the Qubit 1X dsDNA HS Assay protocol.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 0.5mL tubes for 2 standards and samples; label only the lids.
Add 190 µL Qubit 1X dsDNA buffer to standard tubes and 198 µL to sample tubes.
Add 10 µL of Qubit standards 1 and 2 to respective tubes.
Add 2 µL of each sample to the appropriate tube.
Vortex and incubate at room temperature for 00:02:00 before reading.

steps.title: Normalize DNA
steps.instruction: Normalize DNA to 60 ng per sample (approximately 25 to 50 fmol for 2 kb) in a final volume of 12.5 µL for the barcoding step.

steps.title: Prepare End-prep and Barcoding Master Mixes
steps.instruction: Prepare the following in a Master Mix Hood or Clean Room and keep on ice.

substeps.instruction: Master Mix End-prep: 1.75 µL Ultra II End Prep Reaction Buffer and 0.75 µL Ultra II End Prep Enzyme Mix.
Master Mix barcoding: 17.5 µL Ultra II Ligation Master Mix and 0.5 µL Ligation Enhancer.

steps.title: Perform End-prep Reaction
steps.instruction: Conduct this 'one-pot ligation' step in the PCR room.

substeps.instruction: Add 2.5 µL Master Mix End-prep to 12.5 µL of pre-normalized DNA (~60 ng). Mix well.
Incubate in thermocycler at 20 °C for 00:10:00, then 65 °C for 00:05:00.
Place on ice for 00:00:30.

steps.title: Perform Barcoding Reaction
steps.instruction: Conduct this step in the PCR room using a single native barcode (NBXX) per biological sample.

substeps.instruction: Add 2.5 µL NBXX barcode to the 15 µL end-prepped DNA.
Add 18 µL barcoding mix and mix well (Total volume: 35.5 µL).
Incubate at 20 °C for 00:15:00, then 70 °C for 00:10:00 to inactivate ligase.
Place on ice.

steps.title: Pool Samples and Clean-up
steps.instruction: Pool all barcoded samples (35 µL per sample) into a 1.5 mL (or 2.0 mL if >20 samples) Eppendorf tube.

substeps.instruction: Add Ampure beads at a 1:1 ratio to the pooled DNA.
Incubate for 00:05:00 in the HulaMixer.
Spin down and place on a magnetic rack for 00:03:00 until clear.
Wash with 500 µL 80% (v/v) ethanol: add ethanol, remove from magnet, turn 180º, place back on magnet, and discard ethanol.
Repeat the ethanol wash once more.
Spin down, remove residual ethanol, and air dry for 00:02:00.
Resuspend in 32 µL EB and incubate off the magnet for 00:02:00, then spin down.
Transfer the clear solution to a clean 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Adapter Ligation and Final Clean-up
steps.instruction: Dilute 100-200 fmol (~150 ng for 2 kb) of pooled sample to 30 µL in Elution Buffer (EB) and set up the following reaction in a 1.5mL tube:

substeps.instruction: Reaction components: 30 µL cleaned-up barcoded amplicon pools, 10 µL NEBNext Quick Ligation Reaction Buffer (5X), 5 µL AMII Adapter mix II, 5 µL Quick T4 DNA Ligase.
Incubate at RT for 00:30:00.
Add 50 µL Ampure beads (1x volume), spin down, and place on magnetic rack until clear.
Remove supernatant and wash with 200 µL SFB (do not use 80% ethanol). Repeat SFB wash.
Spin down, remove residual SFB, and add 14 µL EB; resuspend by flicking.
Incubate at RT for 00:02:00, place on magnetic rack, and transfer solution to a clean 1.5 mL tube.
Quantify 2 µL via Qubit (recovery aim: 50-100 fmol, 61.80 - 123.6 ng for 2 Kb).

steps.title: Nanopore Sequencing Setup
steps.instruction: Prepare the flow cell and software for sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Thaw Sequencing buffer (SQB), Loading beads (LB), Flush buffer (FB), and Flush tether (FLT) at room temperature, then place on ice.
Insert the chosen flow cell into the MinION or GridION device.
In MinKNOW software, select flow cell type FLO-MIN106 : R9.4.1.
Configure New Experiment: Kit LSK109 (no barcoding kits), Run length 12 hours, 'high accuracy basecalling' enabled.
Start the run.
